description: Stage a draft. With send_at it is scheduled. A draft can be saved without to, but needs one to be sent or scheduled. With reply_kind it starts as the reply to, or the forward of, the email in_reply_to_message_id names, which needs the read scope too: leave agent out, since the email's agent sends it, and asking again answers with the draft already open.

list_unsubscribe.description: Adds RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe headers (List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post), for newsletters, digests and other recurring mail. One click suppresses the address for the whole workspace. The message needs exactly one recipient: one `to`, and no cc or bcc.

reply_all.description: With reply_kind "reply": also copy everyone else on the email.

reply_kind.description: Make this the reply to, or the forward of, the email named by in_reply_to_message_id.
